candidate_crop_additional_bbox_area_loss.justification: One percent permits annotation-boundary overlap while rejecting material crop damage.

minimum_bbox_retention_due_to_candidate_.justification: Candidate geometry must not materially remove a labeled person.

padding_percentage_max.justification: Reject synthetic/masked pixels when a measured rectangular candidate exists.

source_fov_retained_fraction_min.justification: At most five percent bounded source-area loss is admissible.

mandatory_rejection_gates.condition: source_unit == CELSIUS and canonical_unit == CELSIUS and canonical_dtype == float32
rotation == 0 and horizontal_flip == false and vertical_flip == false

metric_definitions.additional_bbox_area_loss_due_to_candida: candidate-crop area loss / source-frame-clipped person-bbox area; fraction; thresholded before ranking
metric_definitions.anisotropy_ratio_excess: max(horizontal_scale_factor, vertical_scale_factor) / min(horizontal_scale_factor, vertical_scale_factor) - 1; dimensionless; lower is better
metric_definitions.mean_absolute_shift_celsius: mean absolute candidate-minus-source frame mean; degrees Celsius; lower is better
metric_definitions.padding_percentage: masked/non-measured canonical pixels / canonical pixel count * 100; percent; lower is better
metric_definitions.range_compression_distance_from_one: abs(mean range_compression_ratio - 1); dimensionless; lower is better
metric_definitions.round_trip_mae: diagnostic downsample/reconstruction mean absolute error; degrees Celsius; lower is better
metric_definitions.source_fov_retained_fraction: candidate crop area / distributed source-frame area; fraction; thresholded before ranking

policy_justification: FOV and bbox thresholds define an admissible geometry set without model output.
Within admissible geometry, anisotropy is minimized before physical-statistic distortion.
Bilinear is the declared deterministic interpolation preference; this is not an antialias claim.
Candidate ID is only the final neutral reproducibility tie-break.
tie_break_rule: candidate_id ascending after all declared numeric ranking fields are tied within numeric_tolerance
